units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:12">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> <he>בשעה שהיא כ׳</he> when it (the jewel) shone faintly.—Pl. <he>כֵּהִים</he>, <cite ref="K00154"><he>כֵּהוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="K00151"><he>כֵּי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:12">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:1:7">Y. Pes. I, beg. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>בשעה שהיו כ׳ וכ׳</he> when the lights burned dimly, we knew it was day-time. Ib. 27ᵇ top <he>בשעה שהיו כיהות</he> when the jewels were dim.—Pesik. Kumi, p. 145ᵇ (ref. to <he>כ̇ה̇חלנות</he> <cite ref="Ezekiel 40:25">Ez. XL, 25</cite>) <he>חלונות כ׳ היו</he> the windows were dim (stained glass).
<cite ref="Chagigah 16a:9">Ḥag. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>עיניו כ׳</he> his eyes will grow dim; a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 2:2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>לפי שהכ׳ נראית עזה</he> because (in the early morning &c.) the faint spot appears bright; Sifra Thazr., Neg., <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 2">Par. II</cite>, ch. II.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 1:1:5">Y. Shebu. I, 32ᵈ</cite> <he>הִכְהָה טמא הִכְ׳ מן הַכֵּ׳ טהור</he> if it grows one shade fainter, it is unclean, but when it grows fainter than the next fainter shade, it is clean; Sifra l. c. ed.
